# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOL_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After lunchtime volatility compression (12:00‑13:00 ET), a breakout of the prior hour’s range with elevated volume often initiates a trending move. This captures the tendency for liquidity to re-engage post-lunch, where compressed volatility precedes directional expansion as institutional activity resumes.

## Mechanism

At 13:00 ET, compute the 5‑minute ATR(5). If it is below the 20‑period lowest ATR(5) of the day (volatility compression), AND price breaks above the high of the 12:00‑13:00 ET hour with volume > 1.5 × the average volume of the last 20 bars, go long. Symmetrically go short if price breaks below the low of that hour with the same volume condition. Exit: initial stop at the opposite side of the compression range (low for long breakout, high for short), target 2R, then trail using a premium‑stop (trail 10% of ATR) for a runner.
